name: frozen-skills
description: Installs reviewed delegation-contract, Doppler, external-skill-intake, OMC maintenance, and official PDM operations skills. Content under _incubator is not included.

skills.name: delegation-contract
skills.description: Brief and receive work from subagents so intent survives the handoff. Use when delegating multi-phase work, spawning subagents or parallel workers, writing a Task or Agent prompt, fanning out research, or deciding whether to delegate at all. Covers what a spawn prompt must carry, what a worker must return, and which work must stay single-threaded.
